'''Spring Frenzy (3 April 2026 – 5 June 2026)'''
==Rewards== {| class="tds-table pad-10" style="text-align: center; margin:1em auto" !Coins Reward !EXP Reward |- ! colspan="2" |Easy Rewards |- |{{Coins|200}} ÷ (1 + [(20 ÷ Current Wave) - 1]^1.3) + {{Coins|50}} (Triumph Bonus) |{{Exp|40}} ÷ (1 + [(20 ÷ Current Wave) - 1]) + {{Exp|35}} (Triumph Bonus) |- ! colspan="2" |Hard Rewards |- |{{Coins|800}} ÷ (1 + [(25 ÷ Current Wave) - 1]^1.3) + {{Coins|200}} (Triumph Bonus) |{{Exp|200}} ÷ (1 + [(25 ÷ Current Wave) - 1]) + {{Exp|31}} (Triumph Bonus) |} ==Triumph Rewards== Triumphing '''Bathroom Approach''' can give out an additional reward upon triumph, these rewards are: *{{Color|Common}} (47.39%) **{{TimeScaleTicket|Time Scale Ticket}} (2-4) **{{ReviveTicket|Revive Ticket}} (2-3) **{{SpinTicket|Spin Ticket}} (2-3) **[[Low Grade Crate]] **[[Easter Egg]] (2-4) *{{Color|Uncommon}} (28.44%) **[[Ducky Squad]] (2-3) **[[Mid Grade Crate]] *{{Color|Rare}} (18.96%) **[[High Grade Crate]] **[[Napalm Strike]] (2-3) **[[Blizzard Bomb]] (2-3) *{{Color|Legendary}} (4.74%) **[[Nuke]] *{{Color|Common|Custom}} (0.47%) **[[Molten Monster (Consumable)|Molten Monster]] ==Milestone Rewards== Triumphing this map on the Hard difficulty for the first time also gives the [[Biologist]] tower. The second triumph gives the Biologist Bundle ([[Biologist Menace]], [[Biologist Nametag]], [[Canister Throw]]) while the third triumph gives the {{Color|DuckyRevenge|Grim}} skin. The second triumph reward had to be done 64 hours after the first one, while the third one had to be done 64 hours after the second triumph.
